title: osteospermum lanosum
intro: Osteospermum lanosum, commonly known as the Woolly Daisy, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The health benefits of Osteospermum lanosum include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in protecting against cell damage and reducing inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Osteospermum lanosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
